observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same book cover for 'Monster Mission' by Eva Ibbotson.
The cover art features a large, dark-feathered bird with a large, pale, rounded beak and a single large eye.
The background is a starry blue sky, and the bird is perched in a nest made of green twigs.
A small white bird is perched on a twig in the nest.
The title 'Monster Mission' is written in large, stylized purple letters.
The author's name, 'EVA IBBOTSON', is printed above the title.
A quote at the bottom reads: 'This kind of fun will never fail to delight.' — Philip Pullman.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'BURAHED' are visible across both photos.
No ISBN, publisher, or edition details are visible on the cover.
